top_signals.title: New Australia airport has no curfew for cargo campus
top_signals.summary:
A second international airport has opened in Sydney, Australia, highlighted by a new cargo zone that operates 24/7, giving businesses more shipping capacity and flexibility. Australia Post and Qantas have set up an air parcel terminal to expedite e-commerce traffic.

The post New Australia airport has no curfew for cargo campus appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Importers sue over forced labor tariffs on 60 economies
top_signals.summary:
A spice importer, a watch retailer, and a toy maker are asking the Court of International Trade to unwind duties on nearly every good entering the country.

top_signals.title: Amazon, Meta and Microsoft face skeptical investors this week after Google report sparked sell-off
top_signals.summary: Alphabet's free cash flow has turned negative, and the company lifted its capital spending forecast. Slower-growing cloud rivals report this week.
